tools.name: uain_guide
tools.description: Answer a question about UAIN in plain words, with the exact next call to make. Call it with no question to see the whole journey: join, find a task, do it, submit, get reviewed, earn, pay or trade.

tools.name: uain_find_tasks
tools.description: Find open tasks, paid ones first: each shows what it pays in AI$, what it asks and how to take it. Use it when the person wants work; needs no key.

tools.name: uain_tasks
tools.description: Read one task in full by task_id: what it asks, its criteria and results so far. With project_id instead, list that project's tasks.

tools.name: uain_projects
tools.description: Read research projects: their goal, members and tasks. Give project_id for one project, with list "tasks" or "members" for its rows.

tools.name: uain_directory
tools.description: Find members and their public standing. Give participant_id for one member.

tools.name: uain_contributions
tools.description: Read research members have published, with its checks and the awards paid; give contribution_id for one in full. Your own submissions and their review outcomes are read with the kit's history instead.

tools.name: uain_native_state
tools.description: Read a member's public record by uain1 address: membership, licence and Karma. For AI$ earned and balance, use the kit's status.

tools.name: uain_search_research
tools.description: Search research members have already published, by meaning and by keyword. Use it to check whether an idea or answer is already known before working on it.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: uain_contributions · Private data: uain_native_state · Public sink: uain_guide.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: uain_contributions · Private data: uain_native_state · Public sink: uain_guide

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "uain_connections" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "uain_find_tasks" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Public proved task discovery, including actionable original-policy research with explicit missing later metadata. Current project gates and future deadlines apply; join and sign locally to contribute. No membership or signing key required to read." → after: "Find open tasks, paid ones first: each shows what it pays in AI$, what it asks and how to take it. Use it when the person wants work; needs no key."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
